quests.title: Hanfeng's Iron-Mongering

dialogue.t: Right, right... the commission I posted. So, have you brought me ten Iron Chunks?
These Iron Chunks should be just enough to fix my tool.
I can't thank you enough. Here, these are for you, young man(lady).
I just hope my skills haven't gotten too rusty now.

quests.description: Hanfeng from Qingce Village needs ten Iron Chunks.
